caption_L1: Here a bar plot is called Number of new jobs created in Mexico between January and April 2017 , by state. A categorical scale from Aguascalientes to Zacatecas can be seen along the y-axis, labeled state of Mexico. Number of jobs is measured with a linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 40,000 along the x-axis.
caption_L2L3: The state in Mexico that has the most number of new jobs created is Jalisco. It has created almost 40,000 new jobs. The state in Mexico that has the lowest number of new jobs created is Tabasco.
